title: Research Poster Studio
description: A desktop GUI and command-line application for structured layout authoring of academic research posters from text files (YAML + Markdown + BibTeX), with export to PDF, PNG, HTML, SVG, PPTX, and Marp. Implemented with Tauri v2, React, TypeScript, and Rust; runs on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
